messages:
maria: Heads-up 10: Crestline kickoff tomorrow. They want a 4-week POC covering two flows: (A) support ticket triage (intent + entities) and (B) merchant order summarization. We need a prompt inventory, baseline prompts, a compact eval plan, and a demo cost/latency estimate. @sam_se @lee_ml please weigh in.

sam_se: Do we have sample data & expected concurrency? That determines model sizing and perf targets.

maria: They shared 5k sanitized tickets + 2k order records. Peak ~10 r/s during demo, steady 2-3 r/s otherwise. Prefers Hosted but ok with Dedicated if necessary. Will send security questionnaire about PII.

lee_ml: Proposed baseline acceptance: intent accuracy >= 92%, entity extraction F1 >= 0.88, summary quality pass-rate >= 80% on human checks. Perf target: p95 < 250ms for triage on a 13B quantized endpoint. If cost too high, fall back to 7B with higher latency allowance.

chandra: Security/custodial constraints: require DPA signed before raw PII ingestion. For Hosted POC recommend we pseudonymize customer names/account IDs client-side. If they need raw data in-system, propose Dedicated or Private. Also document: retention window (30d), KMS usage, audit log access.

sam_se: Prompt inventory plan: capture canonical messages + 20 edge-case snippets per flow. Build three prompt templates: baseline (concise instr), guarded (safety + output schema), and few-shot high-precision. Example baseline triage prompt: ```
System: You are a lightweight classifier that returns JSON only.
User: "{ticket_text}"
Assistant: {
  "intent": "<billing|technical|account|other>",
  "entities": [{"type":"order_id|email|product", "text":"..."}],
  "confidence": 0.0
}
``` Keep examples minimal for latency.

maria: Eval harness? Need something runnable we can attach to the POC report.

lee_ml: I'll produce an eval harness: 200 labeled tickets + 200 labeled orders. Metrics: accuracy for intent, entity F1, tokenized ROUGE-L and a 10-sample human scoring rubric (0-3) for summaries. Harness will call Redwood API and emit per-call token counts & cost. Ill place code + runbook in a share link.

sam_se: Pricing guidance for Crestline demo: estimate hosted POC cost $250	600 over 4 weeks at expected traffic (we'll show per-1k-token calc). If Dedicated requested, show reserved capacity quote and minimum commit.

chandra: Also include security appendix in the deliverable: data handling steps we took, pseudonymization script, retention settings, and the DPA next steps.

maria: Timeline suggestion: week0 prep (prompt inventory + baseline prompts); week1 run eval harness on baseline; week2 iterate prompts & perf tuning; week3 integrate into demo flows + produce POC report; week4 acceptance & handoff. Can we promise a concise POC report by EOW week3?

lee_ml: Yes, deliver initial eval artifact by EOW week1 and a draft report EOW week3.

sam_se: I'll prepare a pricing/ops slide deck with fallback options (7B for lower cost, Dedicated for SLA) and a short runbook for demo operations (throttling, model swap, logging).

ops-bot: Reminder: if Dedicated infra is required, open a capacity request at least 5 business days before demo.

maria: Action items: @lee_ml share eval harness link, @sam_se pricing slides, @chandra security checklist + pseudonymization script. Sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:
